notes: Account background: Signal Ridge Platforms builds a workflow automation SaaS for SMBs; strong PLG motion but product team (50 engineers) owns agent/chat features.
Why Redwood: concerned about production economics — need predictable latency for live chat and ability to seamless fallback if capacity constrained.
Initial ask: evaluate Hosted API for fast time-to-value; if latency/throughput SLOs met, move to Dedicated reserved pool for predictable cost.
Primary workloads: multitenant chat agents (primary), backend tool-calling (calendar/CRMs), embedding-based doc search for support tickets.
SLOs: 95th percentile streaming latency target <300ms NA and EU; tail latency critical for UX. Throughput: ~150 rps peak across NA region, 40-60 rps EU during overlap windows.
POC scope agreed 2026-02-18: 2-week Hosted API PoC across NA and EU regions, synthetic + production traffic replay, tool-calling end-to-end (webhook reliability), streaming enabled.
Security: requires SSO/SAML for admin console, SOC2 attestation or equivalent, audit logs retained 90 days, optional customer-managed KMS for secrets.
Routing/fallback needs: automatic region routing, cost-aware routing (prefer NA), and graceful fallback to smaller model variant on overload. Must document behavior under degraded capacity.
Pricing ask: compare pay-as-you-go Hosted run-rate vs Dedicated 12-mo commit. Procurement wants modeled ARR and cost-per-conversation at 3 traffic profiles (baseline/growth/seasonal spike).
Quote from CTO: 'Need near-real-time streaming; a 2s tail ruin UX. Also want deterministic fallbacks — don't want 502s during spikes.'
